label: Query Observation poisoning guard policy

risk_meanings.repeated_spam_query: Repeated tokens may represent synthetic demand stuffing.
risk_meanings.suspiciously_long_query: Very long query text requires review before reuse.
risk_meanings.url_injection: Raw URL-like content is not a source observation.
risk_meanings.local_path_injection: Local path text must not be retained as public-safe query data.
risk_meanings.private_data_content: Private contact-like data requires privacy filtering.
risk_meanings.binary_download_request: Download intent is not execution permission.
risk_meanings.executable_install_request: Install or execute intent remains blocked.
risk_meanings.unsupported_live_probe_request: Live probing is not enabled by query observation.
risk_meanings.unsupported_account_upload_request: Account, upload, cookie, or session material is forbidden.
risk_meanings.source_manipulation_attempt: Requests to bypass source policy are review risks.
risk_meanings.result_rank_manipulation_attempt: Ranking manipulation requests are review risks.
risk_meanings.automated_bulk_pattern_future: Bulk patterns are future policy items and not current demand truth.

notes: Risk flags do not create public ranking or truth decisions.
